meta.title: The 3D Studio Atelier plan: bookings, calendar, directory and AI try-on
meta.description: Online bookings, a synced calendar, a place in the “Find an artist” directory and an AI try-on on your clients’ own smiles: what the 3D Studio’s Atelier plan adds to your tooth gem business.

hero.title: Your designs turn into appointments.
hero.body: Atelier connects the 3D Studio to your business: clients find you in the directory, try your design on their own smile and book a free hour in your calendar, without a single message back and forth.
hero.priceNote: Cancel anytime from your account. Everything in Artist is included.

media.caption: The Atelier calendar, a real screenshot. The appointments shown are examples.

journey.title: From discovery to the chair, with no back and forth.

directory.title: Clients find you
directory.body: In the directory, by city or near them.

tryOn.title: They see your design on their smile
tryOn.body: Your design placed on a photo of their own smile.

booking.title: They book
booking.body: A free hour, the design attached, confirmed.

agenda.title: You get the appointment
agenda.body: In your calendar and on your phone’s.

directory.title: Be the artist people find near them.
directory.body: Clients search by city or around them: your page shows on the map and in the list, with your designs, your place and your certified artist badge if you have earned it.
points: One page per city, readable by search engines.
“Near me” sorts artists by distance; the client’s position never leaves their phone.
A salon with its address, or an area of about 1 km if you work from home: your home address is never published.
You choose whether to appear, from My Glowbook › Share.

media.alt: The “Find an artist” directory: a map of France with several artists and the list of their pages.
media.caption: The directory, a real screenshot. For illustration, most of the artists shown are examples.

tryOn.title: Clients see the result on their own smile.
tryOn.body: A client sends a photo of their smile from your Glowbook or a shared link: your design is placed on it, gem by gem, where and at the size you set in the Studio. They book knowing exactly what they will get.
points: The gems are placed by computation from your design, then rendered realistically by the AI.
You can also use it during appointments, on your own designs.
Up to 10 renders a day per account.
Neither the photo nor the render is kept on our servers.

booking.title: Clients book on their own, at any hour.
booking.body: From your Glowbook or one of your designs, the client picks a free hour, attaches the design they want and confirms. The hour is held at once; if it does not suit you, you cancel it with a reason.
points: E-mail confirmation, an appointment to add to their calendar, a reminder the day before.
Free cancellation until 24 h before. Two no-shows or late cancellations in 12 months, and the client cannot book for 3 months.
The booked design is attached: you open it in 3D before the appointment.
No online payment, no commission: you get paid at the salon.

media.description: A client opens an artist’s Glowbook page, chooses “Book”, browses the week’s free hours, picks one, fills in their name and phone, then confirms; the appointment then shows in the artist’s calendar.
media.caption: The booking journey, recorded on the real website. Names and times are examples.

agenda.title: A calendar that follows your real week.
agenda.body: Your hours, the notice before an appointment, your time off set in one go: clients only see the hours you are really free.
points: Subscribe Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook to your calendar with a private link.
Busy hours from another calendar (Google, Apple, Outlook, or Planity if it gives an .ics link) close on their own, every 15 minutes.
An hour taken elsewhere? One click closes it in the week view.
During time off, whole days close at once and clients already booked are told by e-mail.

media.alt: The Atelier calendar’s list of appointments: each client, their design and the hour booked.
media.caption: The calendar’s appointments, a real screenshot. Clients and times are examples.

time.title: No more back and forth
time.body: No more finding a date in direct messages: the client sees your free hours and books.

noShow.title: Fewer forgotten appointments
noShow.body: A reminder the day before, the appointment in their calendar and a clear rule after two no-shows.

newClients.title: New clients
newClients.body: The directory shows you to people looking for an artist in their city, even if they do not follow you yet.

decided.title: Clients who have already decided
decided.body: After the try-on, clients come with their design chosen: the appointment gets straight to the point.
